Court/ National Green Tribunal/ State

considered and accounted for?
column3:
There is no demand on account of illegal
mining as imposed by the Hon’ble
Supreme Court/ National Green
Tribunal/ State Pollution control Board
as on 31.03.2024.
However, demand notices amounting to
₹ 1,73,444.60 Million have been issued
in respect of 47 Projects/Mines/
Collieries of the company by State
Government (District Mining Officer) in
pursuance of the judgement dated
02.08.2017 of Hon’ble Supreme Court
of India vide W.P. (C) No. 114 of 2014 in
Common Cause vs. Union of India &
Others.
Based on the judgment received from
Revisional Authority, MoC and legal
opinion, the above demand has been set
aside.
